Ethan — quick operational notes and a small ask to speed reconciliation:

1) Micro-deposit amount: confirmed $0.17. Please look for the deposit from "Redwood Inference - PAYOPS" on or about Mon, Jul 6. Reply with the exact amount and the trace reference (if visible) and we will complete activation.

2) Beneficiary naming: please ensure the beneficiary name on your bank record exactly matches the legal name on the W-9 ("Lumos AI, Inc."). Mismatches cause delays in ACH reconciliation.

3) Remittance fields: our AP requires two fields in the remittance CSV for automated posting — invoice_number and reference_token. The reference_token must be the PO token you agreed ("PO:RED-4991"). If your file uses separate columns, map them like this: invoice_number -> col1, reference_token -> col2.

4) Preferred payment rails: we will default to ACH for recurring US payments and wire when explicitly requested on a per-PO basis. If Lumos prefers wires for high-value invoices, please flag that at invoice submission.

Attached: supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (filled copy — please sign and return).
